privacy.title: Privacy notice
privacy.controller: This Secret Santa site is run by {name}, the data controller, as a private service for friends and family. Contact: {email}.
privacy.purpose: Your data is used only to run the gift draw and email each participant who they give a gift to. The legal basis is the legitimate interest of the organizer and the operator in running this exchange.
privacy.data: First and last names, email addresses, wishlists, the draw result, and creation timestamps.
privacy.recipients: The event organizer (who sees the participant list), the operator's email provider (to deliver emails) and the hosting provider. Your data is not sold or used for advertising.
privacy.retention: An event and all its data are deleted automatically 30 days after the event date, or 12 months after creation when no date was set.
privacy.rights: You can ask {email} for access, correction or deletion of your data. If you believe your rights are not respected, you can lodge a complaint with the CNIL (www.cnil.fr).
privacy.access: The operator can technically read the database, including the draw, but does not look at it. The organizer can also see and change participant email addresses, which is how a lost link is resent.
